target_contract.row_selection: Use every one of the 247 persisted R02 rows for route execution. Score the 233 rows with selection_role=scored (163 train and 70 holdout); report the seven zero_vds_invariant and seven repeated_low_vds_audit rows separately without adding them to scored aggregates.
target_contract.split_use: Train and holdout scored rows are reported separately; the 14 audit rows are retained as separate invariants/reproduction checks. Holdout is never used for route tuning, syntax repair, parameter selection, or threshold changes.
target_contract.external_data_use: No external baseline current, teacher spreadsheet, or literature curve may replace or augment the 247 frozen project target rows.

device_contract.equations: Only the two generated R02 candidate routes are compared; no TCAD, trap, contact, temperature, HZO, or circuit equation is added.

port_mapping.single_bottom_gate: Use the frozen row VBG as the active gate and set VTG=0 V exactly.
port_mapping.symmetric_dual_gate: Apply both frozen VBG and VTG values without rebalancing or fitting eta_dg.
port_mapping.reported_current: absolute drain current divided by W, in A/cm; preserve one sign convention for both routes

ngspice_behavioral.invocation_contract: Batch invocation must use the frozen candidate and a generated device-only DC netlist; no interactive edits or circuit netlist reuse.
ngspice_behavioral.allowed_claim: Executed behavioral translation comparison only; never native HSPICE Level 61 and never a physical parameter card.

aimspice_level15.route_kind: AIM-Spice native Level 15 candidate with explicit dual-gate control wrapper
aimspice_level15.invocation_contract: A documented batch or command-line invocation is required; a GUI-only result or undocumented manual edit is not reproducible formal evidence.
aimspice_level15.allowed_claim: Executed AIM-Spice Level 15 route comparison only; not equation identity, experimental calibration, or foundry model validation.

required_route_checks: candidate files and mapping hash exactly
subcircuit and model names match the contract
both routes expose D/TG/BG/S and use frozen W/L values
no external baseline path is included in generated netlists
no SnO or HZO asset is read
tool executable fingerprint is recorded before execution
syntax/preflight logs are persisted separately from numerical results

metric_contract.aggregate_weighting: Equal weight per complete scored curve; report train and holdout separately; audit rows are not added to scored aggregates and no points are pooled to hide a curve.
metric_contract.route_difference: For every frozen row and curve report absolute and log route-to-route differences; route disagreement is a required diagnostic, not a tunable pass threshold.
metric_contract.threshold_policy: Reuse the frozen M00 descriptive thresholds only as labeled route-to-target diagnostics; do not retune candidates to meet them. M01 acceptance is complete, auditable two-route comparison with explicit differences and limitations, not forced equation agreement.

excluded_assets: all SnO files and P-type assets
old circuit netlists and old VTC/oscillator/full-adder outputs
TCAD state files and unregistered sensitivity variants

evidence_boundary.contract_claim: E3 static contract only; no simulator was invoked and no M01 numerical result exists. A prior revision-1 checker failure is retained as historical evidence.
evidence_boundary.future_pass_allowed_claim: Two executed simulator routes were compared on the frozen IGZO teaching target rows with explicit route differences and reproducible syntax/tool logs.
prohibited_claims: equation identity between behavioral ngspice and native Level 15
experimental fitting or physical IGZO parameter extraction
native Level 61 claim for the behavioral route
circuit readiness, inverter, ring oscillator, full adder, layout, PEX, HZO, or foundry sign-off

next_gate: After this revision-3 static contract is committed and pushed, perform only the declared tool preflight and then the two-route device-only M01 run. Any route/tool failure is retained and stops M01; C00 and all downstream stages remain closed.
